review.notes: review of the change against main: 98 changed lines since 74a09b7. Checked: the new Layer 9 in full, every statement recomputed. Inversion law of 9.2: sign, constant and det(Z/i)^r by hand at Z = iY, and numerically at general Z in the Hermitian half-space for (r,s) = (1,1), (1,2), (2,1), (2,2), with three wrong variants excluded. Cohen-Resnikoff normalisation comparison (H = 2G, covolume det(H)^s vol, dual H^-1 of the source's dual) and both Examples (s = 1 equals 4.2; Z[i] at z = i, 1.0074837 on both sides). Changed sentences elsewhere (overview, build order, Convention 19, scope, references) and the merge-base README layer by layer: nothing removed or renumbered. Seeded sample where it falls in affected text (2.1, 3.1) against the pinned Tau Ceti. HermitianFormsAndLattices 7.1's citation of 9A-9B. Overlap with seven closest roadmaps: nothing shared. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean (unchanged) elaborates with 10 sorry warnings only. Cohen-Resnikoff 1978 and Resnikoff 1975 could not be read legally, so no locator was checked against text. Two small corrections: the Lean carrier of the real form 2 Re h is unnamed; the description omits Layer 9. Two format notes.
